title: Completed STAKEHOLDER ENGAGEMENT ASSESSMENT MATRIX Data Contract
description: Additive structural schema validating completed STAKEHOLDER ENGAGEMENT ASSESSMENT MATRIX artifact data payloads (PMO-04.10.02).

stakeholder_identity_and_project_role.description: Name, organizational entity, and specific project touchpoint role of the stakeholder.

current_versus_desired_engagement_level.description: Assessment of current engagement (C) versus desired engagement (D): Unaware, Resistant, Neutral, Supportive, Leading.

engagement_gap_and_risk_impact_analysis.description: Strategic risks and schedule or governance exposure resulting from any delta between current and desired state.

targeted_engagement_strategy_and_action_.description: Specific relationship management actions, executive touchpoints, or incentives designed to close the gap.

monitoring_cadence_and_feedback_indicato.description: Schedule for re-assessing stakeholder sentiment and quantifiable indicators of active support.
